results.topSection: Troubleshooting guides · No service or SOS only
results.searchQuery: My phone shows SOS only since this morning
results.reply:
When the phone shows no service or SOS only, first check the outage map for the caller's area. If there is no reported outage, turn airplane mode on for ten seconds and off again, then restart the phone. If the line is past_due or suspended, service is limited until the balance is paid.

Source: Troubleshooting guides · No service or SOS only

results.topSection: Billing and payments · Late payments and suspension
results.searchQuery: I was billed for a travel thing I never ended up using, I'd like that money returned refund eligibility window last charge plus business prepaid travel pass roaming international days billing email autopay payment past due
results.reply:
A failed autopay payment sets the contract to past_due and records the amount owed. After 30 days past due the lines are suspended and can only call emergency services. Business bills cover every line on the account, so a refund returns the whole charge, never a single line.

Source: Billing and payments · Late payments and suspension
